About a quarter of the tickets for "100X Merry MONEY" have been sold. The game is still new. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Everything above about "100X Merry MONEY" comes from the Georgia Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.
1918.headline: How much has sold

1921.body:
Of all the tickets printed for "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES", about two-thirds are still unsold. The game is about halfway through its run, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Everything here about "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" comes from official Georgia lottery numbers, current through November 14.
